ce-n-seasons.label: RCB seasons in the warehouse
ce-n-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ce-n-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (2,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (2,15) OR m.team2_id IN (2,15)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

ce-titles.label: RCB titles, as winner of the season's final
ce-titles.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ce-titles.filters: Final = last match of each season
ce-titles.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (2,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won FROM matches m WHERE m.date = (SELECT MAX(x.date) FROM matches x WHERE x.season_id = m.season_id) AND (m.team1_id IN (2,15) OR m.team2_id IN (2,15))

ce-playoffs.label: RCB seasons with a playoff place
